title: Time-sensitive Federated Learning Participation Device Incentive Method in Industrial Internet of Things

pse.problem: Information asymmetry between edge server and device in existing federated learning leads to additional cost.
pse.solution_function: Design an efficient mechanism to mitigate the impact of information asymmetry, enabling more devices to participate in federated learning while preserving data privacy.
pse.solution_structure: Includes edge servers and industrial IoT devices. Edge servers facilitate federated learning tasks, while IoT devices contribute their own resources and data.
pse.solution_implementation: Uses a time-sensitive incentive mechanism that considers data freshness, device reputation value, local data quality, and available resources. The mechanism encourages fair quantification of participant contribution in federated learning tasks.
pse.effect: Improves the performance of federated learning models by encouraging more devices to participate and addressing information asymmetry.
